generation_meta_data.title: Security review of OAuth implementation
generation_meta_data.description: URGENT: Security team has identified critical vulnerabilities in the proposed OAuth implementation. The current approach stores third-party tokens in localStorage which is vulnerable to XSS attacks. Additionally, the callback URL validation is insufficient and could be exploited for redirect attacks.

generation_meta_data.title: OAuth security vulnerability assessment
generation_meta_data.description: Detailed assessment of OAuth implementation security issues: 1) Token storage in localStorage vulnerable to XSS, 2) Insufficient redirect URI validation, 3) Missing state parameter validation, 4) No PKCE implementation for public clients. Recommend immediate halt of current implementation.
